expo.name: money-manager
expo._comment_splash: The NATIVE launch screen, shown by the OS before any JS runs. Its background matches the canvas colour in src/theme so the handoff to SplashOverlay (which draws the animated mark) is a continuation rather than a colour jump. No image: the placeholder splash-icon.png is Expo's stock artwork, and a plain branded field reads better than stock art.

infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Money Manager uses Face ID to unlock the app, so your accounts and balances stay private.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos to attach receipts to transactions.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera to photograph receipts.
